description:
At Synechron , we harness the power of digital transformation to drive business success. As a global consulting firm, we combine creativity with advanced technology to deliver innovative solutions across industries. Recognized with multiple employer awards, we are committed to building strong expert teams and a collaborative, high-impact work environment.
 
 We are hiring a Data Engineer 
 Hybrid working model – Novi Sad or Belgrade 
 
 Role Description 
 We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable data platforms that support analytics, reporting, and AI/ML initiatives across the enterprise.
 In this role, you will be responsible for developing modern data architectures, building robust ETL/ELT pipelines, and enabling end-to-end data flows that support business intelligence, machine learning, and Generative AI use cases. You will work closely with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Platform Teams, and Business Stakeholders to ensure trusted, high-quality, and accessible data is available across the organization.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and unstructured data
 Build and support modern data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, and real-time streaming platforms
 Ingest, integrate, process, transform, validate, and enrich data from internal and external sources while ensuring high data quality and consistency
 Design and maintain data models that support analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases
 Collaborate with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to provide curated datasets and support feature engineering initiatives
 Develop batch and real-time data processing solutions using distributed computing technologies
 Support integration of data pipelines with machine learning training, deployment, and monitoring workflows
 Implement data governance, security, privacy, and compliance controls aligned with enterprise standards
 Optimize data pipelines and platforms for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency
 Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions while proactively troubleshooting failures and resolving performance bottlenecks across data platforms
 Maintain data lineage, metadata, documentation, and audit-related artifacts
 Support data migration, modernization, and cloud transformation initiatives
 Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate deployment processes and CI/CD pipelines for data workloads
 
 Your Profile 
 Must Have Requirements 
 Proven experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Big Data Engineering, or a related field
 Strong hands-on experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and enterprise data architectures
 Advanced knowledge of SQL and data modeling principles
 Strong programming experience with Python and/or Scala
 Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases
 Experience with data lakes, data warehouses, and large-scale analytical platforms
 Hands-on experience with Big Data and distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark or Hadoop
 Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform
 Knowledge of real-time data streaming and event-driven architectures
 Experience implementing data governance, data quality, and security best practices
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
 Experience with CI/CD, automation, and version control practices
 Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience supporting AI/ML pipelines, feature stores, model training, or MLOps initiatives
 Experience within banking, financial services, fintech, or other highly regulated industries
 Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, or Google Dataflow
 Experience with Apache Kafka or Azure Event Hubs
 Experience with Airflow or other workflow orchestration platforms
 Knowledge of Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, or similar database platforms
 Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable monitoring solutions
 Azure Data Engineer Associate certification
 AWS Data Analytics Certification
 Google Professional Data Engineer Certification
 Databricks Certification
 
 What’s in it for you: 
 Competitive compensation package based on experience and skills
 Flexible hours and hybrid work options, allowing you to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs
 Private health insurance plan
 Access to continuous training, accredited certifications, and a range of resources to help you grow professionally
 Personalized leadership training program
 FitPass membership to support your well-being and mental health support programs
 Comprehensive Referral Rewards Program
 
 For any additional information or questions, feel free to reach out to us at Recruitment-Serbia@synechron.com .
 
 Note: One of the prerequisites for this position is that the prospective candidate must possess a valid work permit for Serbia.
 
 We appreciate the interest of all applicants. Please note that only those whose qualifications closely match the position requirements will be contacted for the next steps. All applications will be handled confidentially.
 S​ YNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT 
 
 Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more. 
 
 All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law .
